cities.name: London
cities.description: As our home base, London is where we do our best work. From the grand halls at Delta Armouries to the vineyard elegance of Bellamere Winery, we know every venue's quirks and how to light them perfectly.
cities.focus: Full-service lighting for London's premier wedding venues

cities.name: Kitchener-Waterloo
cities.description: The tri-cities are home to some of Ontario's most stunning event spaces. We bring professional-grade lighting to venues like Langdon Hall and Victoria Park Pavilion, transforming already beautiful spaces into something extraordinary.
cities.focus: Elegant lighting for KW's upscale venue scene

cities.name: Guelph
cities.description: Guelph's blend of heritage charm and modern elegance makes it a dream to light. Whether it's the riverside beauty of River Run Centre or the manicured grounds of Cutten Fields, our lighting elevates every celebration.
cities.focus: Heritage and garden venue lighting specialists

cities.name: Stratford
cities.description: Known for its theatre heritage, Stratford demands lighting that tells a story. We bring dramatic, stage-quality lighting to venues like Revival House and the Stratford Country Club — because your wedding deserves a standing ovation.
cities.focus: Theatrical, story-driven lighting for Stratford's cultural venues

cities.name: St. Thomas
cities.description: St. Thomas is the heart of the boutique barn and farm wedding scene. Rustic beams, open fields, and starlit skies — we add the warm glow that turns a beautiful barn into a magical one.
cities.focus: Rustic barn and farm wedding lighting

cities.name: Woodstock
cities.description: Woodstock's charming small-town feel and countryside venues are perfect for intimate celebrations. Our lighting packages are sized right for Woodstock — big on impact, scaled to fit.
